CoinShares: Digital Asset Investment Products See $3.55B in Weekly Inflows, Largest This Year CoinShares’ digital asset biweekly report, published on September 29, showed that global digital asset investment products recorded approximately $3.55 billion in net inflows last week, the largest weekly inflow of the year, after flows were broadly flat over the previous two weeks. Total assets under management rose to approximately $173 billion, while year-to-date inflows reached $8.6 billion. By asset, Bitcoin products saw $2.52 billion in inflows, followed by Ethereum with $702 million, Solana with $193 million and XRP with $92.3 million. — link

MetaMask: Security Incident Affects Part of Infrastructure, No Immediate Threat to Wallets Identified MetaMask is responding to an ongoing security incident affecting part of its infrastructure, with no immediate threat to MetaMask wallets identified at this time. The company is working with external partners and security advisers to address and remediate the issue. As a precaution, MetaMask is proactively exiting affected validators from its non-custodial staking operations in coordination with clients and partners. Its staking operations are non-custodial, and MetaMask does not manage withdrawal keys on behalf of clients. — link

Bybit Releases 40th Proof-of-Reserves Report Bybit released its 40th proof-of-reserves report based on a Sept. 23 snapshot. User holdings stood at about 56,100 BTC, up 0.24% from Aug. 26, and 551,900 ETH, up 2.96%. USDT holdings fell 11.46% to about 3.59 billion, while USDe holdings surged 62.41% to roughly 516 million. — link

Highlight Clip: Arthur Hayes: Hyperliquid Is the Best DEX, but Not Necessarily the Most Profitable Investment Arthur Hayes: Hyperliquid Is the Best DEX, but Not Necessarily the Most Profitable Investment Flop Labs CEO Arthur Hayes said in a September 12 interview with VirtualBacon that Hyperliquid is the best-run decentralized exchange today, and he believes the project will continue to grow.However, from an investment-return perspective, Hayes said Hyperliquid is already very large, making another 5x gain much harder. In his view, Hyperliquid may be the best DEX, but not necessarily the most profitable investment. By comparison, lower-market-cap tokens that have fallen more sharply may require much less additional market value to deliver higher multiples. WuBlockchain note: Arthur Hayes has a relatively poor historical track record on market forecasts and frequently adjusts his views. His analytical framework may be more useful to follow than his specific price targets or timing calls. — link
